text:
arjun: Anybody seen this weirdness in the onboarding sample app? If a token rotates during a long streaming /v1/generate we sometimes see a duplicate POST arrive at the backend without Authorization then a 401. Repro on Pixel/emulator Android 13/14.

beth: which okhttp + retrofit and how are you applying auth headers? interceptor or call-factory?

arjun: Retrofit 2.9, OkHttp 4.10.0, Kotlin suspend wrapper that calls call.cancel() on coroutine cancellation. Headers added in an Interceptor. We do a blocking refresh inside the interceptor right now (legacy).

carla: blocking refresh in interceptor is problematic. Use an Authenticator for 401 flows and a single in-flight refresh (CompletableDeferred/Deferred) so you don't hit the refresh endpoint twice. Also add a guard so the refresh request itself isn't authenticated.

dmitri: also note parity quirk: our Java sample used Call.Factory pre-wrapping which preserved headers at enqueue time; Kotlin interceptor approach showed the naked retry. Call.Factory vs Interceptor matters for connection-level retries.

arjun: interesting. We saw the Java sample didn't reproduce the naked retry. So parity is real. Any immediate workaround for the sample app while we bump okhttp?

beth: quick mitigations that helped us: 1) mark refresh requests with e.g. `X-Refresh-Request: 1` and make Authenticator/Interceptor skip them, 2) use a separate OkHttp client for token refresh (no auth interceptors), 3) for streaming client set `retryOnConnectionFailure(false)` so non-repeatable bodies are not silently resent, 4) centralize refresh with a single-inflight promise.

carla: we added a tiny utility in samples: a Mutex + nullable CompletableDeferred<String> to dedupe refresh calls. Pseudocode: `if (deferred != null) return deferred.await(); else withLock { create deferred; perform refresh; complete deferred; }`

darwin-note: (typo)

dmitri: bumping OkHttp to 4.11.1 removed most of our header-propagation issues in similar projects. There were fixes around retries and header reapplication. Recommend upgrade in samples + a devex note about supported versions.

arjun: ok I'll open a small PR: (a) bump OkHttp to 4.11.1, (b) add single-inflight refresh util, (c) set streaming client `retryOnConnectionFailure(false)` behind a feature flag, (d) add X-Refresh header and skip logic. Will include reproducible steps and emulator images.

ci-bot: CI: sample-app/canary build queued for PR arjun/devex/stream-auth-fix-2123456789.

qa: filing FLK-2311 for emulator Pixel 8 streaming auth race; attach logs to the PR. Please include the minimal repro and which emulator images you tested.

arjun: thanks all. If upgrade + dedupe still shows edgecases we'll add a short devex doc explaining Call.Factory vs Interceptor parity, Authenticator pattern, and streaming caveats.

beth: also consider adding a small test in our SDK parity suite that runs both Java and Kotlin samples through the same streaming auth sequence so we catch regressions early.

arjun: good idea, I'll add that to the PR checklist.
